summary: Temporary danger area EGD298C near Coventry, within 1.8 nautical miles, up to 900 feet above sea level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD298C INSTALLED WI 1.8NM RADIUS OF
522429N 0013037W (COVENTRY). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS 
CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG SER ACFT MAY 
ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION 
AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS ARE 
PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER 
NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE 
APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR 
RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY 
TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. 
WILL BE REPLACED BY EGD298D FROM 24 NOV. AR-2026-2281/08.
